description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest' that tests the 'BuzzDao' class's methods for adjusting like and comment counts on shares and comments within the 'OrangeHRM' system. It sets up fixtures for testing, executes methods to adjust counts, and asserts expected values for likes and comments on specific BuzzShare and BuzzComment entities.

classes.name: BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzDao methods related to adjusting like and comment counts on BuzzShare and BuzzComment entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture data before each test by loading a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Tests the adjustment of like and comment counts on BuzzShare entities for specific posts.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Tests the adjustment of like counts on BuzzComment entities.
